# Agent Enrollment Protocol

> AEP lets Agents enroll with Services, check enrollment status, and obtain supported session credentials.

For application integration, follow the guided workflow. It first establishes
whether the application acts as an Agent, a Service, or both, then assesses the
repository and proposes an approved, stepwise plan.

## Integration

- [Guided AEP integration](https://www.aep.foundation/integration.md): Start or expand an AEP integration.
- [Integration plan template](https://www.aep.foundation/integration-queue-template.md): Maintain AEP-INTEGRATION-PLAN.md from repository confirmation onward.
- [Coding agents](https://www.aep.foundation/documentation/quick-start/coding-agents/): Developer instructions and a copyable prompt.

## Reference

- [Documentation](https://www.aep.foundation/documentation/): Concepts, role-specific guides, and SDK documentation.
- [Specifications](https://www.aep.foundation/protocol/): Core, identity, claims, and session-credential requirements.
- [Official SDK repositories](https://github.com/aep-foundation): Select the SDK matching the application.

## Separate integrations

- [ODP integration](https://www.offeringprotocol.org/integration.md): Catalog discovery.
- [InFlow Payments integration](https://app.inflowpay.ai/integration.md): MPP and x402 payments.
